## Change

Describe the room, quest, map, story, game, translation or accessibility change.

## Privacy And Rights

- [ ] Only newly created fictional data; no real member/Host/account information.
- [ ] No secrets, production endpoints, telemetry or privileged integrations.
- [ ] I have the rights to contribute this work under the relevant project license.
- [ ] New/changed assets have source, creator, license and credit recorded.
- [ ] Brand/endorsement rules are respected.
- [ ] Source, comments, UI and documentation use English or Japanese.

## Checks

List commands/checks actually completed. State clearly which were not run.
Include keyboard/mobile evidence when relevant, using only fictional data.
## Submission Route

- [ ] Base is kibo-org/kibou-game-community:main.
- [ ] Submission is from my public fork or a maintainer-reviewed patch branch.
- [ ] Commit author/committer identities use GitHub noreply addresses, not personal emails.
- [ ] Only agreed contributor attribution is included; private correspondence/contact details are excluded.
- [ ] Submission does not execute code or deploy; another maintainer reviews the final SHA before merge.
